personal.name: Ishan Paharia
personal.headline: I architect resilient backend systems and pair them with clean, functional frontends.

about: I'm a final-year Computer Science student at The LNM Institute of Information Technology, Jaipur (2023 - 2027), with a strong focus on backend engineering and systems design, and a growing comfort with shipping polished frontends to match.

My work centers on building resilient, real-time systems: horizontally-scaled WebSocket infrastructure, Redis-backed caching pipelines, and transactional database flows that stay consistent under concurrent load.

I've shipped full-stack products end-to-end, from Pixnette (a real-time collaborative pixel canvas) and CoursessionAI (an AI learning platform), to DFilesS (a fault-tolerant distributed file storage system). Outside of building, I spend a lot of time on competitive programming.

projects.title: Pixnette
projects.description: I designed and built Pixnette, a real-time collaborative pixel canvas platform with horizontally-scaled WebSocket infrastructure.

projects.title: CoursessionAI
projects.description: I designed and built CoursessionAI, an AI learning platform that converts YouTube playlists into structured courses with summaries, quizzes, and an AI tutor.

projects.title: DFilesS
projects.description: I designed and built DFilesS, a distributed file storage system that splits files into checksummed 4 MB chunks replicated across 3 storage nodes with a 2-of-3 write quorum for fault-tolerant persistence.
